name: Dish
summary: This porcelain dish is decorated with a design known as 'The Arbour'. It is most likely copied from an original design on a piece of Meissen tableware attributable to the early 18th-century German furniture and porcelain painter Martin Schnell. A number of Meissen bowls exist with this very design.
